newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Domestic fight leads to explosion in South Korea.
newsitem.headline: Domestic fight leads to explosion in South Korea.

text.p: A domestic row led to an explosion early on Tuesday in a three-story house near Seoul when an angry husband lit a gas canister, killing three people including himself and injuring nine, a police official said.

The gas blast in Puchon, west of Seoul, destroyed a couple's home and shattered the windows of two nearby buildings. Forty-five people were evacuated while city officials surveyed the structures, Hwang Sung-hwan told Reuters.
"The two had a fight and the wife slammed the door on her way out. The husband, Kang Hui-chang, who was drunk, grabbed the gas canister and lit it," said Hwang, reading a report on the incident.
